objective.text: Move environment access behind configuration so cached configuration preserves the intended value.

difficulty.rationale: Connect bootstrap caching to a production-only flag defect.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A feature works locally but is disabled after config:cache. BILLING_ENABLED=true exists only in .env, not the process environment. A service reads env("BILLING_ENABLED", false). Which repair retains cached configuration and makes the service use the deployment value?

options.text: Read env in config/billing.php and read config("billing.enabled") in the service; rebuild the cache.
options.rationale: The configuration file captures the environment value when the cache is built, and the service reads that stored configuration.

options.text: Move the same env call into the service provider boot method.
options.rationale: Moving execution to boot does not change cached bootstrap: .env still is not loaded.
options.misconception: Moving execution to boot does not change cached bootstrap: .env still is not loaded.

options.text: Keep the service call and run config:cache again after every request.
options.rationale: Rebuilding is not a per-request solution and does not make cached bootstrap load .env for that service call.
options.misconception: Rebuilding is not a per-request solution and does not make cached bootstrap load .env for that service call.

options.text: Change the service call to env("BILLING_ENABLED", true).
options.rationale: A true fallback masks a missing value and ignores an intended false deployment setting.
options.misconception: A true fallback masks a missing value and ignores an intended false deployment setting.
